title: 3 programming languages that will die by 2028

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Which programming languages might become obsolete by 2028, and why?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Legacy languages like COBOL and Perl are declining as modern tools like Rust and Python dominate enterprise and AI development.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Losing older languages risks erasing decades of institutional knowledge and displacing workers untrained in newer systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Communities are archiving COBOL code and training new developers to ensure continuity in critical sectors like finance and government.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where language evolution is guided by inclusivity and preservation of expertise, not just technological momentum.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of programming balances innovation with responsibility, ensuring progress doesn’t leave people behind.

video_cue: A split-screen showing lines of COBOL code fading into modern AI-driven development environments.
